items.title: Foreign Portfolio Investors Pour Massive Capital Into Indian Stocks During November
items.summary: Overseas institutional investors injected over 84,291 crore rupees into domestic equities within the first part of November. This persistent buying has supported major benchmark indices like the Sensex and Nifty.
items.why: Tracking foreign institutional flows helps market participants understand external liquidity and global appetite for domestic shares.

items.title: Mahanadi Coalfields Submits Prospectus for 9,500 Crore Rupee Public Offering
items.summary: Mahanadi Coalfields has submitted its draft papers for an initial public offering to market regulators. The issue consists of Coal India divesting approximately 66.18 crore equity shares via an offer for sale.
items.why: Initial public offerings allow state-owned enterprises to raise public capital and provide fresh investment opportunities in key primary sectors.

items.title: Market Regulator Outlines Upcoming Artificial Intelligence Guidelines for Securities Ecosystem
items.summary: The Securities and Exchange Board of India is preparing regulatory standards governing automated technology in market operations. The upcoming rules will prioritize investor safeguards, operational transparency, and compulsory human oversight.
items.why: Clear guidelines on emerging technology prevent unchecked algorithmic errors and ensure accountability within financial markets.

items.title: Yes Bank Appeals Bond Write-Off Decision in Apex Court
items.summary: Yes Bank has submitted a review plea to the Supreme Court regarding an earlier judgment on perpetual debt instruments. The previous verdict had blocked the lender's attempt to cancel Additional Tier-1 bonds worth 8,415 crore rupees.
items.why: Legal outcomes on bank capital structures directly influence lender balance sheets and investor confidence in subordinated hybrid debt.

items.title: Industrial Base Metals Retreat as Strong American Currency Dents Demand
items.summary: Base metals experienced downward pressure as the US Dollar Index hovered between 103 and 104 points. Sustained US macroeconomic data and high bond yields contributed to currency strength and dampened global purchasing interest.
items.why: Because globally traded metals are priced in US dollars, dollar appreciation increases import costs for buyers, dampening overall demand.

items.title: Precious Metals Slide Over Four Percent Amid Escalating Rate Expectations
items.summary: Gold and silver experienced weekly declines surpassing four percent despite a modest late-week bounce. Higher US inflation statistics and rising debt yields strengthened assumptions of additional central bank monetary tightening.
items.why: Precious metals generate no yield, making them sensitive to higher interest rates and firmer foreign exchange benchmarks.

items.title: State Governments Offer 23,300 Crore Rupees in Securities Auction
items.summary: Multiple state administrations across India have scheduled an auction to issue debt paper worth an aggregate 23,300 crore rupees face value. The Reserve Bank of India manages these market operations to fulfill state borrowing programs.
items.why: State government bond auctions reveal borrowing costs across regions and indicate institutional demand for sub-sovereign public debt.

items.title: Wall Street Technology Shares Decline Ahead of Critical Sector Checks
items.summary: American technology stocks registered declines as market participants prepared for major milestones in computing infrastructure investments. The retreat mirrors caution surrounding capital spending and near-term corporate developments.
items.why: Major tech companies represent a large share of US indices, making their valuation shifts influential for global risk sentiment.

items.title: Federal Reserve Flags Valuation Risks in Technology Stocks and Leverage
items.summary: The US central bank raised concerns about elevated equity valuations linked to artificial intelligence development alongside rising debt levels. The alert highlights potential vulnerabilities in the financial system if market conditions reverse.
items.why: Central bank risk assessments help investors gauge systemic leverage and whether asset prices match broader economic fundamentals.
